firstPlayerRule: Players plan maneuvers simultaneously. In the Activation phase, the ship with the lowest pilot skill activates first; in Combat, the ship with the highest pilot skill attacks first.
officialTieBreak: When opposing ships share a pilot skill, the player with initiative resolves their ships at that skill first. A player chooses the order among their own ships with the same pilot skill.
clarifications: In this original core rulebook, the Imperial player normally has initiative. Under its squad-building rules, the player with the lower squad-point total has initiative; equal totals give it to the Imperial player.
